subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: If If native timezone support or the installed/published schedule binding is absent, then the system shall Refuse installation or execution with the cause
intent: Unsupported host timezone or schedule-drift/reinstall reason
fit_criterion: Mismatched/unknown timezone refuses install; changed published cron/timezone refuses before claiming; same-date delayed/manual launches use the same daily key without a minute/grace gate
